contexts.text: Their speech is flowing. AC 1760.
A land flowing with... AC 6857. AC 8056.
A fluxion into gyres. DLW 376.
They follow the flux of Heaven.
This is like the flux of the Earth about its axis.
I was permitted to see that flux... and it thus became evident to me that the brain is formed according to the fluxion of Heaven.
They observe whether it flows freely... SE 1209. SE 1569.
Truths... flow as it were freely...
Flowing with = abundance. ( = to be full. AC 10530.)
Believes that all things are of blind flux.
Their speech was softish in its flow.
To the force of its flow () = according to the common state and order in Hell.
The streams stood as a heap () = that those who continually attempted evil could not at all infest... Streams = falsities from evil.
Suffering from a flux () = the profanation of the good of love.
In them there appear as it were flowing forms representative of celestial things.
The circumgyration follows the flux of the interiors of the mind.
From the fluids in and between (the fibres).
To grind meal = to falsify truths.
This means an ointment made from flour and oil; and flour = the truth of faith.
By the meal from barley is signified truth from a natural origin.
By fluxions as it were linear and reciprocal.
Speech of ideas without flow.
Such is the flux of endeavours and forces to their centres.
Thus the evil returns to him by a wonderful... flux of determination.
How the thoughts, endeavours, and forces flow, has been shown by the fluxions of the fibres in our bodies.
He that has an issue () = those who are in natural love separated from spiritual.
To pour streams upon the dry land () = to give intelligence to those who long for truth from good.
The forms of the animal kingdom... are all according to the flux of spiritual substances and forces, which flux, from the endeavour which is in them, is into the human form...
The second form, which is the natural form, in which are all plants, derives its origin from the endeavour and the derivative flux of natural forces, which belong to the atmosphere...
The inflections in the letters derive their origin from the flux of Heaven...
8. By means of a wonderful and inexpressible fluxion into gyres, the Angels formed a likeness of the heart and a likeness of the lungs... and they then followed the flux of Heaven...
